messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

12 years and older: -Initial dose: 10 mg orally once a day; increase if necessary after at least 3 weeks of treatment to 20 mg once a day -Maintenance dose: 10 to 20 mg orally once a day -Maximum dose: 20 mg orally once a day Comments: -Acute episodes may require several months or longer of sustained pharmacological therapy beyond response to the acute episode. -Patients should be periodically reassessed to determine the need for maintenance treatment. Triplet: ["Escitalopram", "used in acute treatment of", "major depressive disorder"]

The relation 'used in acute treatment of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is employed to treat the acute phase of the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
D. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
